card.bar-module.min-must-be-less-than-ma.text: Min must be less than max
card.bar-module.min-must-be-less-than-ma.note: Configuration error of the bar module. Min and max are the lowest and highest value of the bar. Same English as in the gauge, slider and spinbox modules.

card.bar-module.unavailable.note: Shown in a bar when the entity's state is unavailable in Home Assistant (for example the device is offline).

card.button-module.button.note: Name of the button module, shown as the default label. A noun, not a verb.

card.card-helpers.timeout-waiting-for-ta.note: Error when a Home Assistant component did not become available in time. {tag} is a technical element name such as hui-entities-card. Keep it as is.

vars.tag: The value that replaces tag in the text.

card.card-pause.pause-motion.note: Label of the button that freezes all animations on the card, for people who are bothered by movement. A verb phrase.

card.chunk-notice.how-to-clear-the-cache.note: Link text to a help page about clearing the browser cache.

card.chunk-notice.magic-card-updated-tap.text: Magic Card updated. Tap to reload.
card.chunk-notice.magic-card-updated-tap.note: The whole tile is one button shown when parts of the card come from another release. Magic Card is the product name.

card.chunk-notice.magic-card-was-updated.text: Magic Card was updated. Reload the page to see this part. The rest of this card works.
card.chunk-notice.magic-card-was-updated.note: Notice shown in place of a feature that could not load after an update. Magic Card is the product name. This part refers to the missing feature, such as the animation.

card.chunk-notice.part-did-not-load-the-.text: {part} did not load. The rest of this card works.
card.chunk-notice.part-did-not-load-the-.note: Notice. {part} is a phrase with a capital letter that names the missing feature, such as The animation or The slider (see the keys that start with The). It starts the sentence.

vars.part: The value that replaces part in the text.

card.chunk-notice.part-loaded.note: Screen reader announcement after the missing feature loaded. {part} is a phrase such as The animation or The slider (see the keys that start with The).

vars.part: The value that replaces part in the text.

card.chunk-notice.part-of-this-card.note: Fallback in place of {part} when the missing feature has no known name.

card.chunk-notice.reload-page.note: Button that reloads the browser page. A verb phrase.

card.chunk-notice.still-not-loading-try-.text: Still not loading. Try again in a moment, or reload the page.
card.chunk-notice.still-not-loading-try-.note: Notice shown after the Try again button was used and the feature still did not load.

card.chunk-notice.still-the-old-version-.text: Still the old version. Clear the browser cache, then reload.
card.chunk-notice.still-the-old-version-.note: Shown when a reload still loaded the old release. Followed by a link to a help page.

card.chunk-notice.the-animation.note: Name of a feature, inserted as {part} at the start of a sentence. Refers to the animated icon or effect on the card.

card.chunk-notice.the-background.note: Name of a feature, inserted as {part} at the start of a sentence. Refers to the background layers of the card.

card.chunk-notice.the-custom-shape.note: Name of a feature, inserted as {part} at the start of a sentence. Refers to a card shape drawn by the user.

card.chunk-notice.the-flow-style.note: Name of a feature, inserted as {part} at the start of a sentence. Refers to the animated flow look of a line or bar.

card.chunk-notice.the-icon.note: Name of a feature, inserted as {part} at the start of a sentence. Refers to an animated icon.

card.chunk-notice.the-seasonal-effect.note: Name of a feature, inserted as {part} at the start of a sentence. Refers to effects such as snow or fireworks.

card.chunk-notice.the-slider.note: Name of a feature, inserted as {part} at the start of a sentence. Refers to the slider control.

card.chunk-notice.the-text-block.note: Name of a feature, inserted as {part} at the start of a sentence. Refers to a text module with rich content.

card.chunk-notice.try-again.note: Button that tries to load the missing feature again. A verb phrase.

card.config-validator.background-layers-.note: Configuration error for the card's YAML. Keep background_layers exactly as written; it is a setting name. {index} is the position of the layer in the list, as a number.

vars.index: The value that replaces index in the text.

card.config-validator.background-layers-.note: Configuration error for the card's YAML. Keep background_layers exactly as written; it is a setting name. A list is a YAML list.

card.config-validator.background-layers-.text: background_layers: only the first {max, plural, one {# layer is} other {# layers are}} used
card.config-validator.background-layers-.note: Configuration warning. Keep background_layers exactly as written; it is a setting name. {max} is the largest number of layers that is used.

vars.max: The value that replaces max in the text.

card.config-validator.config-must-be-an-.note: Configuration error for the card's YAML: the top level is not a set of keys and values. Config is short for configuration. Object is the technical term.

card.config-validator.config-must-have-a.text: Config must have a rows array
card.config-validator.config-must-have-a.note: Configuration error for the card's YAML. Keep rows as written; it is a setting name. Array means a list.
Configuration error for the card's YAML. The type setting is missing. Config is short for configuration.

card.config-validator.layers-low-power-m.text: layers_low_power must be true or false
card.config-validator.layers-low-power-m.note: Configuration error for the card's YAML. Keep layers_low_power exactly as written; it is a setting name. The words true and false are YAML values; keep them as written.

card.config-validator.pause-button-corne.note: Configuration error for the card's YAML. Keep pause_button_corner exactly as written; it is a setting name. It must be one of the four corners of the card.

card.config-validator.pause-button-must-.text: pause_button must be auto, always or hidden
card.config-validator.pause-button-must-.note: Configuration error for the card's YAML. Keep pause_button and the values auto, always and hidden exactly as written; they are not translated.

card.config-validator.quiet-time-must-be.text: quiet_time must be seconds or H:MM:SS
card.config-validator.quiet-time-must-be.note: Configuration error for the card's YAML. Keep quiet_time exactly as written; it is a setting name. H:MM:SS is a time format (hours, minutes, seconds) and stays as written, for example 0:05:00.

card.config-validator.row-row-col-col-mo.text: Row {row}, Col {col}, Module {module}: layer must be an object
card.config-validator.row-row-col-col-mo.note: Configuration error for the card's YAML. {row}, {col} and {module} are the position numbers of the module in the layout. Col is short for column. Object is the technical term.

vars.col: The value that replaces col in the text.
vars.module: The value that replaces module in the text.
vars.row: The value that replaces row in the text.

card.config-validator.row-row-col-col-mo.note: Configuration error for the card's YAML. {row}, {col} and {module} are the position numbers of the module in the layout. Col is short for column. The module has no type setting.

vars.col: The value that replaces col in the text.
vars.module: The value that replaces module in the text.
vars.row: The value that replaces row in the text.

card.config-validator.row-row-col-col-mo.text: Row {row}, Col {col}, Module {module}: must be an object
card.config-validator.row-row-col-col-mo.note: Configuration error for the card's YAML. {row}, {col} and {module} are the position numbers of the module in the layout. Col is short for column. Object is the technical term.

vars.col: The value that replaces col in the text.
vars.module: The value that replaces module in the text.
vars.row: The value that replaces row in the text.

card.config-validator.row-row-col-col-mo.note: Configuration error wrapper. {row}, {col} and {module} are the position numbers of the module in the layout. Col is short for column. {type} is the module type, such as bar. {error} is a message for that module and may already be translated.

vars.col: The value that replaces col in the text.
vars.error: The value that replaces error in the text.
vars.module: The value that replaces module in the text.
vars.row: The value that replaces row in the text.
vars.type: The value that replaces type in the text.

card.config-validator.row-row-col-col-mo.note: Configuration error for the card's YAML. {row}, {col} and {module} are the position numbers of the module in the layout. Col is short for column. Placement means where the module sits in the layout.

vars.col: The value that replaces col in the text.
vars.module: The value that replaces module in the text.
vars.row: The value that replaces row in the text.

card.config-validator.row-row-col-col-mo.note: Configuration error for the card's YAML. {row}, {col} and {module} are the position numbers of the module in the layout. Col is short for column. {type} is the module type the user wrote, which is not recognised. Keep it as is.

vars.col: The value that replaces col in the text.
vars.module: The value that replaces module in the text.
vars.row: The value that replaces row in the text.
vars.type: The value that replaces type in the text.

card.config-validator.row-row-column-col.text: Row {row}, Column {col} must have a modules array
card.config-validator.row-row-column-col.note: Configuration error for the card's YAML. {row} and {col} are position numbers. Keep modules as written; it is a setting name. Array means a list. Same as the other Row and Col errors, but with Column written out.

vars.col: The value that replaces col in the text.
vars.row: The value that replaces row in the text.

card.config-validator.row-row-must-have-.text: Row {row} must have a columns array
card.config-validator.row-row-must-have-.note: Configuration error for the card's YAML. {row} is the row's position number. Keep columns as written; it is a setting name. Array means a list.

vars.row: The value that replaces row in the text.

card.custom-card-module.card-config-must.text: Card config must be a mapping
card.custom-card-module.card-config-must.note: Configuration error of the custom card module. A mapping is a YAML set of keys and values. Config is short for configuration.

card.custom-card-module.loading-card.note: Shown while the embedded card loads, in the editor preview. Same English as the key in the custom card view.

card.custom-card-module.no-card-type-set.note: Shown in the custom card module when no card type was entered, for example custom:my-card.

card.custom-card-view.loading-card.note: Shown while the embedded card loads, on the dashboard. Same English as the key in the custom card module.

card.forecast-module.day-n.note: Placeholder label for a forecast day in the editor preview. {n} is the day number, starting at 1.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

card.forecast-view.unavailable.note: Shown in the forecast when the weather entity's state is unavailable in Home Assistant.

card.gauge-module.min-must-be-less-than-.text: Min must be less than max
card.gauge-module.min-must-be-less-than-.note: Configuration error of the gauge module. Min and max are the lowest and highest value of the gauge. Same English as in the bar, slider and spinbox modules.

card.gauge-view.unavailable.note: Shown in a gauge when the entity's state is unavailable in Home Assistant (for example the device is offline).

card.graphs-view.no-entity.note: Shown in the graph module when no entity is chosen. An entity is a Home Assistant device or sensor.

card.horizontal-module.empty-row.note: Placeholder shown in the editor in a row layout module that holds no modules.

card.image-module.entity-is-required-whe.text: Entity is required when using entity picture
card.image-module.entity-is-required-whe.note: Configuration error of the image module. Entity picture is the picture that Home Assistant stores with an entity, for example a camera snapshot.

card.info-module.no-entity.note: Shown in the info module when no entity is chosen. An entity is a Home Assistant device or sensor.

card.magic-card.activate-name.note: Accessible name of a module that can be pressed. {name} is the label the user gave to the module. Activate is a verb.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

card.magic-card.activate-type-module.note: Accessible name of a module that can be pressed and has no label. {type} is the module type in English, such as button or image. Activate is a verb.

vars.type: The value that replaces type in the text.

card.magic-card.invalid-configuration-er.note: Error shown on the card. {errors} is a list of the configuration errors found, separated by commas.

vars.errors: The value that replaces errors in the text.

card.magic-card.magic-card-the-visual-ed.text: Magic Card: the visual editor could not be loaded.
card.magic-card.magic-card-the-visual-ed.note: Error shown when the card's editor failed to load. Magic Card is the product name. Visual editor is the graphical editor, as opposed to YAML.

card.magic-card.needs-another-device.note: Shown on a card or module that requires a second device, for example a camera, that is not set up yet.

card.magic-card.no-configuration.note: Short heading of the empty-card state, shown in the card list or preview. Longer sibling: No configuration provided.

card.magic-card.no-configuration-provide.note: Error shown on the card when its YAML is empty. Longer sibling of No configuration.

card.magic-card.pop-up.note: Name of a window that opens over the dashboard, used as its label. A noun.

card.magic-card.template-name-couldn-t-b.text: Template "{name}" couldn't be loaded. Showing this card's own settings.
card.magic-card.template-name-couldn-t-b.note: Warning. A template is a saved set of card settings that cards can share. {name} is the template's name. This message is for a template that exists but failed to load; compare the key that says it wasn't found.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

card.magic-card.template-name-wasn-t-fou.text: Template "{name}" wasn't found. Showing this card's own settings.
card.magic-card.template-name-wasn-t-fou.note: Warning. A template is a saved set of card settings that cards can share. {name} is the template's name. This message is for a template that does not exist; compare the key that says it couldn't be loaded.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

card.markdown-module.markdown-content-is.note: Configuration error of the markdown module. Markdown is a text formatting syntax; keep the name.

card.popup-controller.close.note: Button that closes the pop-up window. A verb.

card.render-module.unknown-module-type.note: Error shown in place of a module. {type} is the module type the user wrote, which is not recognised. Keep it as is.

vars.type: The value that replaces type in the text.

card.slider-layout-module.empty-slider.note: Placeholder in the editor for a slide layout module (a carousel of slides) that holds no slides. Not the slider control.

card.slider-layout-module.next-slide.note: Accessible name of the button that shows the next slide of a carousel.

card.slider-layout-module.previous-slide.note: Accessible name of the button that shows the previous slide of a carousel.

card.slider-module.min-must-be-less-than.text: Min must be less than max
card.slider-module.min-must-be-less-than.note: Configuration error of the slider control module. Min and max are the lowest and highest value. Same English as in the bar, gauge and spinbox modules.

card.slider-module.step-must-be-greater-.note: Configuration error of the slider control module. Step is the size of one move of the slider. Same English as in the spinbox module.

card.slider-view.slider.note: Accessible name of the slider control (a bar you drag to set a value) when it shows in a card. Same English as the key in the view file.

card.spinbox-module.min-must-be-less-tha.text: Min must be less than max
card.spinbox-module.min-must-be-less-tha.note: Configuration error of the spinbox module. Min and max are the lowest and highest value. Same English as in the bar, gauge and slider modules.

card.spinbox-module.step-must-be-greater.note: Configuration error of the spinbox module. Step is how much one press of plus or minus changes the value. Same English as in the slider module.

card.stack-host.not-updated-n-min.note: Warning on stale data in a background layer. {n} is the number of minutes since the last update, at least 1. Min is short for minutes.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

card.text-module.entity-is-required.note: Configuration error of the text module. An entity is a Home Assistant device or sensor.

card.text-module.template-error-error.note: Error in a text module. Template here is a Home Assistant Jinja text template. {error} is a technical message and is not translated.

vars.error: The value that replaces error in the text.

card.text-module.template-is-required.note: Configuration error of the text module. Template here is a Home Assistant Jinja text template, not a saved card template.

card.text-module.text-content-is-require.note: Configuration error of the text module: the text to show is empty.

card.text-module.unavailable.note: Lower case word shown inside text when the entity's state is unavailable in Home Assistant. Not a sentence on its own.

card.vertical-module.empty-column.note: Placeholder shown in the editor in a column layout module that holds no modules.

card.view.couldn-t-set-name.note: Error shown when a slider could not change a value in Home Assistant. {name} is the entity's name.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

card.view.slider.note: Accessible name of the slider control (a bar you drag to set a value) in a card view. Same English as the key in the slider view.
